### Version 1.0.1 Changelog

- Updated documentation for clarity and conciseness, providing a fully bilingual (Chinese and English) overview and step-by-step instructions.
- No code or functional changes; this release is documentation-only.
- Improved structure and readability, making usage guidance and feature descriptions easier to understand for all users.
- Aligned terminology and workflow in both languages for consistency.
- Key sections—such as feature overview, workflow, tag strategy, formatting rules, and error handling—are now clearer and more accessible.

Initial release of toutiao-graphic-publisher skill:

- Enables automated graphic article publishing to 今日头条 (Toutiao) via browser automation.
- Supports intelligent formatting, including title detection, paragraph optimization, and bolding key content.
- Automatically generates and activates 3–5 relevant trending tags based on article content.
- Requires only a manual QR code login on first use; all other steps are fully automated.
- Handles error scenarios with user guidance for login, content issues, network problems, or publishing failures.
